summary: Master the art of financial strategy with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the tools needed for effective financial management.
lede: Strategic financial management connects financial analysis with long-term organizational decisions and value creation. Designed for finance professionals and business leaders, this course helps link financial data to investment and operational choices. It covers evaluating projects with NPV and IRR, optimizing working capital, and identifying financial risks to support clearer decisions and communication with non-financial stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who must bridge the gap between financial data and strategic execution in a corporate environment.
modules: Capital Structure and Cost of Capital
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel. No prior experience in strategic modeling is required, though 2-3 years of professional experience in a finance or management role is recommended.
